definitions.explanation: The state or act of consuming an excessive amount of a beverage, most commonly alcohol. Very common in everyday conversation, especially when describing hangover-related situations.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}みすぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧。
examples.english: Be careful not to drink too much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飲|の}みすぎて⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: I drank too much yesterday and have a headache.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}みすぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧わかって⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、つい⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧しまう。
examples.english: Even though I know drinking too much is bad for my health, I end up drinking anyway.

notes:
The noun form of {飲|の}みすぎる (to drink too much), used to describe the state or act of excessive drinking. Most commonly refers to alcohol, but can also apply to any beverage. Very common in everyday conversation, especially the morning after a night out.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}みすぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be careful about overdrinking
- {飲|の}みすぎで⟦{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}い→気持ち悪い：07154_kimochiwarui⟧: feeling sick from drinking too much
- {飲|の}みすぎた: drank too much (past tense of the verb form)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧すぎ — overeating (same ~すぎ pattern)
- ⟦{二日酔|ふつかよ}い→二日酔い：08331_futsukayoi⟧ — hangover (a common result of {飲|の}みすぎ)
- ⟦{深酒|ふかざけ}→深酒：14790_fukazake⟧ — heavy drinking (more literary)
